Synopsis:
An Italian juvenile court has approved a staged reunification process for a British-Australian family whose three children were removed from their off-grid woodland home in Abruzzo in November 2025. The court's plan allows daytime visits immediately and overnight weekend stays from October, under social services supervision. The family's lawyer intends to appeal for a faster, more complete reunification. The case triggered a broader Italian public debate on alternative lifestyles and state intervention in family matters.
